messages:
Nina R: pro tip: if the compiler gives you a shrug emoji and the runtime gives you an existential crisis, you probably changed a header file. :sweat_smile:
Nina R: pushed a tiny header rename yesterday, CI was green, prod later panicked with `undefined symbol: render_vtable`. fun times.
Owen G: the compiler is like a polite bouncer. runtime is the angry owner who checks IDs again. :tophat::rage:
ci-bot: [CI] build #4872 passed (clang 14), but post-deploy health checks failed for service/model-serving (5xx)
Priya: did you semver-bump? if not, we should add a "therapy" label to the release notes.
Nina R: nope, no semver bump. honestly considering releasing version `0.0.0-alpha-i-m-sorry` after this.
Liam: attached meme: "When your header file ghosts the linker" (imagine a ghost holding a Makefile)
Owen G: also found a YAML in the deploy config where someone wrote `replicas: 2 # maybe` and the parser took `# maybe` as a comment but the human heart took it as betrayal. :laughing:
Priya: can we have a company policy: no inline comments that express personal uncertainty in prod configs. :memo:
Nina R: sharing snippet from the runtime crash log:
Nina R: ```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
  at github.com/redwood/serve.(*Runner).Start (/src/serve/runner.go:214)
  caused by: symbol not found: render_vtable
```
Owen G: classic missing export. linker didn't fail because of LTO settings, which is the compiler's version of "I thought we agreed this was fine."
Priya: new PR rule: if a change touches headers or public symbols, require an integration smoke test. plus an emotional support sticker.
ci-bot: [SYSTEM] created issue #2357: "linker surprise + semver guidance" from failed deploy
Liam: poll: which is worse? A) silent linker fallout B) noisy YAML indentation C) accidental semver major because of punctuation D) all of the above and a Monday morning.
Nina R: D. always D.
Owen G: B for me. YAML will ruin your weekend.
Priya: C because then you have to explain it to product and your calendar becomes sad.
Liam: vote tally: D wins. awarding virtual cookie to the winner. :cookie:
Nina R: fixed by re-exporting the symbol and adding a smoke test. redeployed. moral: compilers are blunt, runtimes are dramatic, semver should come with a feelings check.
Priya: adding a "compiler feelings" section to the dev handbook.
Owen G: next team meeting topic: "Handling Compiler Ghosts and YAML Mood Swings". agenda item 1: bring pizza.
